description:
We are GeoAI Space Explorers, a team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Kénitra, Morocco.

Our interests include geomatics, GIS, remote sensing, Earth observation, and satellite data analysis. We aim to use NASA open data to develop an innovative solution to a real-world challenge.

We are looking for motivated team members with skills in coding, data analysis, AI, web development, and graphic design. Beginners who are eager to learn and collaborate are welcome!
